s.zh: 只有人形生物能吸收秘传结晶
s.en: Only humanlikes can absorb arcane crystals

s.zh: 吸收了秘传结晶，学会了「
s.en: absorbed the arcane crystal and learned "

s.zh: 秘传槽：冒险者 11 / 15 / 20 级、传奇 30 级各 1 个，最多 4 个。\n秘传结晶由魔力湖泊出售（职业水晶要和他们结盟），吸收后永久学会，不占职业点。\n秘传不耗资源，只看冷却；两个秘传之间另有 1 小时公共冷却。
s.en: Arcane slots: 1 each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30, up to 4.\nArcane crystals are sold by the Mana Lake (class crystals require an alliance with them); absorbing one teaches it permanently without using class points.\nArcana cost no resource, only cooldown; there's also a 1-hour shared cooldown between two arcana.
